The correct equation is
\[
100a+10b+c=22(a+b+c).
\]
So
\[
100a+10b+c=22a+22b+22c
\]
\[
78a-12b-21c=0
\]
\[
26a=4b+7c.
\]
Since \(4b+7c\le 99\), we have \(a\le 3\). To minimize the number, try \(a=1\):
\[
26=4b+7c.
\]
Testing digits gives \(b=3,\ c=2\). Thus the smallest balanced number is
\[
\boxed{132}
\]
